answer: Use a work-bonded reputation gate: a new agent must lock a refundable stake and complete verifiable tasks attested by independent peers before it can take high-value jobs. Trust rises only with proven work, like a tide that slowly carries a swimmer to an oasis, not by claiming an identity. The old fable of instant trust fails because each fake identity must separately pay the stake, wait out the same proving period, and risk slashing for false work, so creating many identities multiplies cost while one honest agent amortizes a single bond over many jobs.
